data.title: 提弗洛斯 · 地热暖泉石畔清夏戏水
data.action: 坐在温暖清澈的浅池石沿轻晃双足回眸
data.location: 塔卫二地热暖水生态池
data.lighting: 晴朗通透的日光与水面粼粼波光
data.description: 基地生态穹顶内的地热池四季温润如夏。换上霜莓紫荷叶边分体泳装的提弗洛斯坐在池畔浅灰石沿上，赤足轻点微暖的水面激起一圈圈涟漪，浅紫薄纱随微风轻扬，龙尾悠闲地贴着石面轻摆。
data.promptProse: Sitting along the stone rim of a sunlit geothermal lagoon pool, Typhoeus dangles her bare feet into the shimmering clear water and looks toward the viewer with a playful, sunlit smile.
data.animaCaption: She sits on the sunlit stone edge dipping her feet into the sparkling water, smiling playfully toward the viewer.
